note: Authored release notes — the single source of truth for the in-app changelog (see WORKFLOW.md). Because dev -> main is squash-merged, this is maintained by hand, not generated from git. Add lines to `unreleased` as you work on dev; at release, move them into a new `releases` entry with a SemVer version and date. Keep newest release first.

changes.text: Armour is now calculated on the Overview: Physical Armour from the armour you wear, and Mystic Armour from your Willpower plus any protective gear.

Equipment tab is live. In edit mode, add armour and shields from the rulebook catalogue and equip or unequip them; equipped gear automatically feeds your Armour, Defences, and Initiative. Saved in your browser.
Shields now correctly raise your Physical or Mystic Defence and apply their Initiative penalty, rather than adding to Armour — matching the rules.

Save to a character file: while editing, a Save button writes your changes to a character.json file you pick once and reconnect to thereafter. It saves to both the file and your browser, so they stay in sync — commit the file to keep changes for next time. A dot on the button shows when the file is behind your latest edits. (Chrome/Edge; other browsers keep saving to the browser only.)

Edit mode: use the Edit toggle (top-right, by the theme switch) to make editable parts of the sheet interactive without cluttering the read view. First up — the character's details (description, age, sex, height, weight, skin tone, background); click the name block to edit. Changes are saved in your browser.
Info (ⓘ) icons now stay hidden until you hover what they annotate — the character name and each Special Feature — revealing on approach and always shown on touch, keeping the read view clean.
Closing a details popover with Escape now behaves like clicking away — the ⓘ icon hides again instead of lingering with a focus outline.
Combat panel is now live: Initiative (Dexterity step, less armour), Knockdown (Strength step), and Karma (maximum from race and Circle), each rollable.
Rolls can optionally spend Karma (+D6) on tests your race or Discipline permits, showing the granting Discipline and any condition.
Value tooltips now name the exact source of each modifier (e.g. "Arc 4", "Net 2") instead of a generic "discipline".
Karma indicators now use a distinct green, keeping amber as the general accent.
Tabbed character sheet: Overview, Disciplines, Spells, Gear, and Notes.
Overview dashboard — attributes, defences, armour, health, movement, and combat at a glance.
Special Features panel showing racial abilities and their linked traits.
Exploding-dice roller with a result modal for rollable stats.
Rules engine: Physical, Mystic, and Social Defence derived from attributes plus racial and discipline effects.
Light and dark theme toggle, with the choice remembered.
Character details modal with portrait, background, and vitals.
Self-hosted the UI framework so the app loads reliably and works offline.
